_help: Tier 3, weak-coherent BB84 with decoy states at the single-photon level (attenuated pulsed laser near 850 nm, signal, weak-decoy, and vacuum intensities chosen at random per pulse, silicon single-photon detectors, FPGA timing). Log the intensity class of every pulse in the alice_intensity column; the decoy-state analysis then bounds the single-photon detections [ma2005]. Dark-count probability is per detection window (about 300 counts/s in a 3 ns window). Ten-million-pulse sessions keep the statistical margins on the decoy gains small.
